title: thoracosperma depressa
intro: Thoracosperma depressa, commonly known as the "Thorny Olive" or "Makabuhay", is a plant species native to the Philippines that is rich in medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, making it a popular remedy in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Thoracosperma depressa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant work together to provide a range of health benefits, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
